summary: Evaluate the writer-hold objective as a maximum latency target

schema.detail: No persisted schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: The writer-hold objective uses its configured max_ms target and the maximum-latency evaluator: any over-target sample in a reported window misses the objective. Its hourly budget is all or nothing, like the transaction maximum targets, rather than a p99 allowance.

compatibility.detail: The writer-hold objective row now displays max and the configured target instead of p99 and an absent target defaulted to zero. Existing objective row fields and telemetry reports are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores the previous objective presentation and evaluation.
